categories.name: Tokenized Closed-End Funds (CEFs)
categories.content: Tokens representing shares of closed-end funds (CEFs), a typed of pooled investment vehicle that raises capital once and issue a fixed number of shares, with no ongoing creation or redemption mechanism. Tokenized CEFs are issued by a tokenization platform that holds the listed fund shares in custody and mints tokens against them, so the token inherits the fund's market price rather than its NAV.

categories.content: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC) refers to social media platforms and protocols that operate without a central authority over user data, content, or infrastructure.

categories.name: ERC 404
categories.content: ERC-404 is an experimental token standard that aims to bridge fungible tokens and NFTs to enable liquidity and fractionalization.

categories.name: Yield Tokenization Protocol
categories.content: Yield tokenization protocol refers to protocol taking a yield-bearing asset and splitting the future yield stream out to distinct token.

categories.name: LRTfi
categories.content: LRTfi refers to DeFi protocols that are built upon Liquid Restaking Tokens, allowing users to earn additional yield from their staked assets by restaking them.

categories.name: Fixed Interest
categories.content: Protocols that involved in providing financial products that include fixed interest.

categories.name: NFT Strategy Flywheel
categories.content: The NFT Strategy Flywheel is a DeFi-NFT hybrid model that automates NFT accumulation and token burning using trading fees to drive continuous buy pressure and value accrual for token holders.

categories.name: NFTStrategy Ecosystem
categories.content: NFTStrategy is an automated protocol that converts crypto trading fees into buying and selling floor NFTs, creating a self-sustaining value loop for NFT collections.

categories.name: Bitcoin Sidechains
categories.content: Bitcoin Sidechains are designed to enhance the Bitcoin blockchain's capacity by creating a new layer that improves transaction processing speed by handling transactions off the primary chain.

categories.name: Prediction Market Tools
categories.content: Cryptocurrencies representing projects that function as an application or tooling layer on top of decentralized prediction markets (like Polymarket, Kalshi etc.) to offer enhanced utilities. These platforms do not offer their own prediction bets and markets and instead leverages the liquidity, data, and settlement mechanisms of underlying prediction markets to provide enhanced user experiences, such as trading terminals, copy-trading bots, parlay engines, or social betting interfaces.

categories.name: LSDFi
categories.content: Liquid Staking Derivatives Finance (LSDFi) combines the principles of liquid staking derivatives with traditional DeFi applications to offer enhanced financial opportunities and flexibility to cryptocurrency users.
